Extracted 31 October 2026 (overnight run agentpack-r23) from the guide (src/guides/cardinsight.guide.tsx, self-contained) and docs/evidence/cardinsight.md at b4988c5, the commit the copy snapshot records. The evidence's newest section, “c8526ae publish (23 October 2026, #284)”, replaces the earlier ones where they differ; the earlier sections were checked on 19 October (c7d3348, #283) and 17 October (a116616). So the 17 October lines that the default footer is an empty nudge with no prop for its text, that the default caption is invisible, that Emphasis Medium and Low hide the bar's fill, that a custom footer gets the card's modes only, that code never shows the divider without a footer and that CardInsight can't pass onClose are out of date and not used; each item citing the evidence carries the date and build of the section it quotes (all 0.1.78, so the trace check does not flag them). Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). GitHub's compare of v0.1.78-c8526ae and v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (2 commits, 163 files, complete) changes no CardInsight, Nudge, SavingsGoalSummary, LinearProgress, MetricLegendItem, Badge, Divider, Button, IconButton, Icon, design-tokens, react-utils or typography file; CardInsight.tsx (f49466a), Nudge.tsx (bfa6689), SavingsGoalSummary.tsx (b43731a), LinearProgress.tsx (bf3dba7), Badge.tsx (b091d4d), Divider.tsx (c351125), MetricLegendItem.tsx and Button.tsx are the same blobs at both tags and in node_modules. So nothing the 23 October check read has changed. Every sentence quoted here was read against the installed source (token values through the package's own getVariableByName in lib/commonjs), and the guide page was rendered on it in headless Chrome at 1280 px (31 October, this run). Source: the card is a View, or with onPress a Pressable with role button named accessibilityLabel ?? title, accessibilityState disabled and a fixed style, so no pressed or disabled look (CardInsight.tsx 288–307); white with a 1 px white border, radius 12, padding 16 top and bottom and 12 at the sides, gap 12, and no width of its own (100–112, 211–221); the header is a row whose text column (flex 1) holds the title, 16 px weight 700 with no line limit, and the subtitle, 12 px, then the badge (225–268); badge false, null or left undefined renders none, a string a Badge with the card's modes, a node gets the card's modes (149–156); children left out gives SavingsGoalSummary label “Credit usage” (158–164), whose rows default to fixed amounts, Current (4 months) 240000 and Recommended (8 months) 480000 (SavingsGoalSummary.tsx 106–114), and whose caption now reads text/appearance/high/color, rgb(0, 0, 0) (237–239); the default footer is an inline-compact Nudge with body footerBody (default “One line of guidance.”), buttonLabel footerButtonLabel (default “Button”) and modes { AppearanceBrand: 'Neutral', Context: 'Nudge&Alert', ...modes }, with onPressFooter, onClose and showClose passed only when set (166–185); a footer node gets the same modes (187), and footer false or null renders none (173); the Nudge draws its button when buttonLabel or onPressButton is set (Nudge.tsx 301–313), so an empty footerButtonLabel with no onPressFooter leaves no button, and a label with no onPressFooter gives a button that does nothing; the divider follows the footer when unset, and true or a node stays with footer false (191–209, 282). LinearProgress keeps its track at Emphasis Low and its fill at High whatever Emphasis it is given (LinearProgress.tsx 33–39), and Badge with Semantic Intent System and Emphasis High reads Emphasis/badge/high/fg, white (Badge.tsx 27–37). Rendered: every guide card is 356 × 336.6 in its 356 px frame (the Sizing mark reads 336.5); the default footer is 58 px with a 25 px button; with no AppearanceBrand on the card the footer's surface is white, rgb(255, 255, 255) (nudge/background with AppearanceBrand Neutral), with a grey sparkle rgb(84, 89, 97) and a dark button rgb(48, 51, 56); Secondary gives a lavender footer rgb(246, 243, 255) with a purple button rgb(93, 0, 181), Tertiary a pale blue one rgb(236, 247, 255) with rgb(3, 107, 153); the bar is 23 px, gold rgb(206, 161, 90) on rgb(253, 232, 201) by default, purple rgb(93, 0, 181) on rgb(237, 231, 255) with Secondary, blue rgb(3, 107, 153) and dark grey rgb(48, 51, 56) on grey rgb(235, 235, 237) with Tertiary and Neutral; the badge is gold with a near-black label by default and white-labelled in the other three; the long badge (170 px) puts the title on two lines (40 px against 20); the paragraph subtitle makes the header 86 px; pressing Set up in In context leaves the footer with no button. Tokens also confirm the evidence facts: Page type SubPage and context 8 Section turn the border rgb(235, 235, 237); Semantic Intent System colours the badge (positive rgb(0, 119, 61), white label), the bar and the footer; LinearProgress Size L is 23 px and M 16 px. Left out because the installed package, and the page rendered on it, contradicts them (in the human flag, for the guide fix): the Configuration sentence's “The footer is grey” (the default footer has no grey surface: it is white on the white card, with a grey sparkle and a dark button), so /configuration/1 quotes it only from “with a dark button” on, and the Primary card's “The default: a gold badge and bar, with a grey footer.” is not used; Anatomy's Divider note “A 1 px rule, shown only with a footer.” (the guide's own States sentence and CardInsight.tsx 200–209 keep a passed divider without a footer), so the Divider part rests on the divider fact; and the Do & Don'ts description's “or leaves its footer empty” (since c8526ae the Don't shows the default copy, “One line of guidance.” and “Button”, not an empty footer). Unclear, and kept with a second item: In context's “the screen passes a new hint and no button label” means an empty footerButtonLabel (the guide's code passes '' at line 103; left out, the label reads “Button”), so /configuration/9 states it from the evidence's “An empty footerButtonLabel with no onPressFooter gives a footer with no button.” and /examples/1 passes footerButtonLabel="". Out of date and not used: the Sources note's “(23 October build)” (the installed build is 27 October, with every file this card renders unchanged) and “The published Storybook predates this build.” (the published index.json was last modified 31 October 2026, 01:30 UTC, and still lists the six stories the Sources note names; the stories were not re-read). Kept, because the installed source agrees: every Anatomy note but the Divider's, the Configuration sentences on AppearanceBrand (gold, purple as in Figma's bar, blue and grey badge and bar; the card, title and subtitle unchanged), on badge, children and footer, every States, Sizing, Content and In context sentence, and all three Do & Don't pairs. Package facts: title, subtitle, badge, footerBody and footerButtonLabel show Figma's sample words when left out (types facts), so the content rules make setting them required, scoped to the default footer for the footer's two; onPressFooter is required whenever the default footer shows a button, on the evidence fact that the button does nothing until it is set (the Sources note's “set its hint, button label, and action, as these examples do” says the same). children is a recommended configuration item, not a required rule: the fact and the evidence give the default figure (a SavingsGoalSummary captioned “Credit usage”), but nothing the entry can cite calls its amounts samples (they are fixed in the source, above). SavingsGoalSummary: it has no entry in pack.json, and neither has LinearProgress, so under “Use only components with an entry” no example passes a figure. Every guide example passes the same configured SavingsGoalSummary (FIGURE, cardinsight.guide.tsx line 13: Saved (4 months) 240000 against Goal (8 months) 480000, no caption); the examples leave children out, so the card shows its default figure in its place, and the first example's purpose says so and that the screen's figure needs a component this pack doesn't cover (to report). Anatomy and /configuration/5 still name SavingsGoalSummary, as the guide and the package do. avoidWhen rests on the evidence's record of Biscuit's handwritten CardInsight.mdx (upstream, not shipped in the mirror), as CC Card's entry does; BenefitCard and CardFinancialCondition have entries, so those items carry useInstead; “several insights in one card” names no component. Placement: the In context composition is the one place the guide sets the card (a VStack under a Title on the Insights screen); the screen owns the footer's state. Strength: no quote used holds must, never, always, only or required (the one that does, the Divider's “shown only with a footer”, is left out above); the required items rest on package facts. Anatomy required: the title, subtitle and figure always render (each has a default); the badge, divider and footer can be removed. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every card, the Title and the VStack), no Slot gap on the In context VStack, no style (the guide's width 100% and maxWidth 356 are its docs frame; the card fills its host), no AppearanceBrand (the Configuration cards show the options; no guide sentence says some content needs one). The first two are the guide's In context before and after Set up (lines 100–105), the third its Without the footer card (line 74), all with the guide's own copy; onPressFooter stands for the screen's action. VStack has a guide entry, Title an undocumented one. Left out of examples (three at most): the anatomy and sizing specimens, the four AppearanceBrand cards, Without the badge and Without the divider, the Content card (the same card as the first example), the Do & Don't specimens, the playground and its readout, and the status readout under In context. Related entries: Nudge (guidance/nudge.json) agrees: its button renders when buttonLabel or onPressButton is set (/configuration/8), which is why an empty footerButtonLabel with no onPressFooter leaves the footer with no button; it says to leave Context to the Nudge, and CardInsight's footer sets Nudge&Alert itself (a Context in the card's modes would override it); its gap that onPressButton without buttonLabel renders an empty, unnamed button would apply here only if a screen kept onPressFooter with an empty label, which the guide doesn't do. Badge (guidance/badge.json) agrees: a status in a few words, not a sentence (/content/rules/0–1), matches “a one- or two-word status”; its Semantic Intent advice reaches a CardInsight badge through the card's modes, which also recolour the bar and the footer (the Semantic Intent evidence fact), or through your own Badge node in badge. Not recorded: onClose and showClose beyond their evidence fact (no guide sentence), style, the modes the guide doesn't cover beyond the evidence facts (Appearance / DataViz, Emphasis / DataViz, AppearanceSystem, Badge Size, Border Boolean, Button / Size and / State, Context, Context2, context 10, Nudge padding, Profile Card Appearance, Slot gap, Text Appearance; Color Mode by the building rules), the Sizing paddings and gaps (the card sets them itself), Figma's 356 × 322 and fixed parts, the Storybook story list and the evidence's measurements from a116616 and c7d3348. Gaps: Figma's green badge and purple 16 px bar against the package's gold defaults, still so on dbe0e02 (badge/color/background Primary rgb(206, 161, 90); the default figure's bar 23 px). #284 (empty default footer, invisible default caption, Emphasis Medium and Low hiding the bar's fill) is fixed on c8526ae and #283 (System badge label) on c7d3348, as the evidence says, and the installed source confirms each (Nudge body and button; the caption on text/appearance/high/color; LinearProgress's fixed Emphasis; Badge's Emphasis/badge/high/fg), so neither is a gap.
Sorting (run agentpack-r23, two cross-check runs). Round 1 raised no flags. Its notes: /useWhen/1 reads the In context title as a use (kept, as UPI Handle's entry does with its In context title); /configuration/1 drops “grey” from the footer sentence (intended: that word is the guide fix above); /examples/1's new hint looked invented, and /examples/0 called the action a monthly transfer, an inference from the hint. Both purposes were tightened: /examples/0 now says onPressFooter stands for the screen's action behind Set up, and /examples/1 that its hint is the one the guide's In context code passes once Set up is pressed (cardinsight.guide.tsx line 103: “₹10,000 moves to savings on the 1st of each month.”, which the page shows after the press, rendered this run; the copy snapshot was read before it). Round 2, on this entry, raised no flags; its notes repeat that a human should check that string against the guide's source (line 103, above) and call the dropped “grey” harmless. No dismissals. Left: the human flag for the guide fix (#546, filed by the coordinator); no trace-check or cross-check flag remains. Coordinator, 31 October (round 3): /avoidWhen/0 and /avoidWhen/1 say “the handwritten Storybook docs” rather than naming their author, as Category Card’s entry says “the upstream Storybook docs”; the evidence quotes they rest on are unchanged.

examples.purpose: A savings insight on the Insights screen, the guide's In context before the plan is set: a Title for the screen and the card in a VStack. The card names the finding (the title, one sentence of context, a short status badge) and its footer gives one hint and one action; onPressFooter stands for the screen's own action behind Set up. children is left out: the guide's figure is a SavingsGoalSummary (Saved (4 months) ₹2.4L against Goal (8 months) ₹4.8L), which has no entry in this pack, so the card shows its default figure in its place, a SavingsGoalSummary captioned “Credit usage”. The screen's own figure goes in children: report that it needs one.

    footerBody="Add ₹10,000 a month to reach it by June."
